name: Dorset and East Devon Coast
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: The Jurassic Coast runs for about 96 miles along England's southern shore, from Exmouth in Devon to Studland Bay in Dorset. Its crumbling cliffs reveal 185 million years of Earth's history, from desert to tropical sea, along with fossils, sea arches and stacks. Mary Anning found her famous marine reptiles at Lyme Regis, and the whole route can be walked on the South West Coast Path.
